# Stefan Auvache Bradley

> Stefan Auvache Bradley is a software engineer and writer. He applies iterative principles from software engineering and project management — such as Agile methodology, feedback loops, sprint planning, and experimentation — to personal growth, career decisions, and intentional living. His site, stefanauvachebradley.com, is home to his writing on Agile Personal Development and his weekly newsletter, Food for Thought.

Stefan holds a Master's degree in Information Systems Management from Brigham Young University and lives in Vancouver, Washington with his family.

Agile Personal Development is the practice of applying iterative, experimental frameworks from software engineering and project management to personal growth. The core cycle is: plan a little, act, measure what happened, and iterate. Instead of rigid long-term plans, this approach uses small experiments and thoughtful iteration to build a life you actually want.

- [About Stefan Auvache Bradley](https://www.stefanauvachebradley.com/about): Bio, background, and what Agile Personal Development means.

## Topic Hubs

- [Living the Agile Life](https://www.stefanauvachebradley.com/articles/agile): Apply software engineering principles to build a more intentional, fulfilling life.
- [Iteration Over Planning](https://www.stefanauvachebradley.com/articles/iteration): Use experiments and short-term goals to find direction and make adjustments.
- [The Destination Dilemma](https://www.stefanauvachebradley.com/articles/destination-dilemma): How to set worthwhile goals if you don't know what you want.
- [Systems Over Chaos](https://www.stefanauvachebradley.com/articles/systems): Build sustainable productivity systems to create space for what matters.
- [Learning From Failure](https://www.stefanauvachebradley.com/articles/failure): Turn setbacks into data and use failure for continuous improvement.
